Bubble- flux is a QoS management framework that enables precise online QoS guarantees and increased co-location opportunities in warehouse scale computers (WSCs) by leveraging a combination of hardware and OS support, and that it is the first to provide online QoS management with precise guarantees for latency-sensitive applications in WSCs.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose Bubble-flux, a new online QoS management framework for WSCs.

we have designed and implemented a novel online QoS prediction technique, Bubble-flux, which is able to accurately predict the QoS of latency-sensitive applications in a wide range of co-location scenarios, even when the applications have phase changes or are running at different load levels.
we propose Bubble-flux, a dynamic QoS management system that can precisely predict the QOS degradation that results from the performance interference of multiple co-running applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance interference between applications in WSCs is highly dynamic, and therefore, static profiling is not sufficient to predict performance interference and ensure QoS.
it is possible to accurately predict the performance of a co-running application on a given host without profiling.
the QoS degradation from performance interference can be precisely predicted and managed in real time, even for multiple co-running latency-sensitive applications.
